parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.txn_id, t.txn_time, t.description, t.category, t.amount,
         t.status, t.channel, a.account_type, a.last4,
         CASE WHEN t.channel = 'card' THEN k.last4 END AS card_last4,
         CASE WHEN t.channel = 'card' THEN k.status END AS card_status
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cards k ON k.account_id = a.account_id AND k.card_type = 'debit'
  WHERE a.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM c)
    AND t.txn_time > now() - make_interval(days => $3::int)
    AND (coalesce($4, '') = ''
         OR t.description ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%'
         OR t.category ILIKE $4)
    AND (coalesce($5, '') = '' OR a.account_type = $5)
  ORDER BY t.txn_time DESC
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT
  (SELECT customer_id FROM c) AS customer_id,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(tx ORDER BY tx.txn_time DESC), '[]'::json) FROM tx) AS transactions;
